options.content:
- **Included:** apiserver, controller-manager, scheduler, kube-proxy, flannel and node-remediation; kubelet and native services exported by cAdvisor.
- **Etcd and pod containerd:** historical CPU/memory metrics are not currently exported. Client latency to etcd does not establish quorum health or replace etcd metrics. `/system/runtime` is the system containerd, not `/podruntime/runtime`.
- **VPA:** recommendation-only; workload-wide request targets. `upperBound` is not a recommended limit either. Control-plane static Pods have no VPA.
- **Leaders:** controller-manager and scheduler each concentrate work on one CP; apiserver runs actively on all three.

title: K8s: control plane capacity and health
description: Control-plane VM capacity, Kubernetes component usage versus requests and limits, CPU throttling, VPA request recommendations, leadership and API health.
